title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.15454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucial innovations. First, we introduce a variable-length prediction window that aligns with the latent tokens, or segments, of a hierarchical LM. Second, we implement a novel attention-masking scheme that enables parallel byte prediction without violating causality. translated_title: 基于分层语言模型的动态多字节预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15454v1 公告类型：新 摘要：字节级分层语言模型（LMs）最近已成为其使用子词分词的热门对应模型的一种稳健替代方案。然而，一次生成一个字节仍然是推理速度的瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们引入了多字节预测（MBP），该技术可并行生成多个字节，从而在最小化性能影响且不增加额外参数的情况下加速推理。MBP基于流行的多令牌预测（MTP）范式，并包含两项关键创新。首先，我们引入了一个可变长度的预测窗口，该窗口与分层LM的潜在令牌或片段对齐。其次，我们实现了一种新颖的注意力掩蔽方案，使得在不违反因果性的前提下实现并行字节预测。我们证明，多字节预测在多种生成任务、指令遵循、问答、摘要和机器翻译中实现了帕累托最优的权衡。
tldr: 本文提出了一种动态多字节预测方法，通过可变长度预测窗口和创新的注意力掩蔽机制，在分层语言模型中实现并行字节生成，从而在不增加参数的情况下显著提升推理速度并保持性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces dynamic multi-byte prediction with a variable-length prediction window and a novel attention-masking scheme, enabling parallel byte generation in hierarchical language models to accelerate inference without parameter overhead or significant performance loss.
